page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8369HB cores running at 3.3 GHz with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates mid-tier performance across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1576.79 and a multi-core score of 33292.22. Memory subsystem testing shows a read-only bandwidth of 1856.41 GB/sec for cached small blocks, which drops to 114.67 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 53.49 GB/sec. Computational capabilities are further highlighted by a Passmark CPU score of 31757.66 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11662.0.

The lack of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring network storage overhead for disk-heavy operations. However, the dedicated CPU allocation and 25 Gbps network bandwidth support consistent throughput for network-bound tasks. The instance delivers balanced resource density for general-purpose workloads, showing strong execution in database operations with 12244.88 Passmark database operations and a Redis SET throughput of 31.14 million operations per second. It is suited for web serving, software compilation, and database hosting.
